options.content:
## Transformers vs GGUF
Same Phi-3, two engines: Hugging Face PyTorch (`baseline` / `rag`) vs llama.cpp GGUF (`baseline_gguf` / `rag_gguf`). Quality (`rougeL`) should stay close; **time_to_response** and **tokens_per_sec** are the runtime story.

panels.title: Run — what you are looking at
panels.description: The selected run's identity, per device leg. `run_id` matches `results/runs/<run_id>/` on disk. Rows written before run identity was added to the schema have no run_id and are excluded from every panel here.

targets.rawSql:
-- One row per device leg of the selected run. Rows written before run_id
-- existed have no run and never appear here.
SELECT run_id,
       MIN(run_started_at) AS run_started_at,
       COALESCE(device, 'unknown') AS device,
       COALESCE(MAX(runtime), 'transformers') AS runtime,
       MAX(model_name) AS model,
       COUNT(DISTINCT question) AS questions,
       COUNT(*) AS answers,
       ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (MAX(timestamp) - MIN(timestamp)))::numeric, 1) AS wall_s,
       'results/runs/' || run_id || '/' AS export_folder
FROM evaluation_metrics
WHERE run_id IS NOT NULL AND split_part(run_id, '_', 1) || '_' || split_part(run_id, '_', 2) = ${run:sqlstring}
GROUP BY run_id, COALESCE(device, 'unknown')
ORDER BY run_id

SELECT CASE approach
           WHEN 'baseline' THEN 'Baseline'
           WHEN 'baseline_gguf' THEN 'Baseline (GGUF)'
           WHEN 'rag' THEN 'RAG'
           WHEN 'rag_gguf' THEN 'RAG (GGUF)'
           WHEN 'fine_tuned' THEN 'Fine-tuned'
           WHEN 'fine_tuned_with_rag' THEN 'Fine-tuned + RAG'
           ELSE approach END || ' · ' || COALESCE(device, 'unknown')
         || ' (n=' || COUNT(*) || ')' AS series,
       AVG("rougeL") AS rouge_l
FROM evaluation_metrics
WHERE approach IN ('baseline', 'baseline_gguf', 'rag', 'rag_gguf') AND "rougeL" IS NOT NULL AND run_id IS NOT NULL AND split_part(run_id, '_', 1) || '_' || split_part(run_id, '_', 2) = ${run:sqlstring}
GROUP BY approach, COALESCE(device, 'unknown')
ORDER BY CASE approach
           WHEN 'baseline' THEN 1
           WHEN 'baseline_gguf' THEN 2
           WHEN 'rag' THEN 3
           WHEN 'rag_gguf' THEN 4
           WHEN 'fine_tuned' THEN 5
           WHEN 'fine_tuned_with_rag' THEN 6
           ELSE 7 END, 1

panels.title: Avg time to response — Transformers vs GGUF

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE approach
           WHEN 'baseline' THEN 'Baseline'
           WHEN 'baseline_gguf' THEN 'Baseline (GGUF)'
           WHEN 'rag' THEN 'RAG'
           WHEN 'rag_gguf' THEN 'RAG (GGUF)'
           WHEN 'fine_tuned' THEN 'Fine-tuned'
           WHEN 'fine_tuned_with_rag' THEN 'Fine-tuned + RAG'
           ELSE approach END || ' · ' || COALESCE(device, 'unknown')
         || ' (n=' || COUNT(*) || ')' AS series,
       AVG(COALESCE(time_to_response, generation_time)) AS ttr
FROM evaluation_metrics
WHERE approach IN ('baseline', 'baseline_gguf', 'rag', 'rag_gguf') AND generation_time IS NOT NULL AND run_id IS NOT NULL AND split_part(run_id, '_', 1) || '_' || split_part(run_id, '_', 2) = ${run:sqlstring}
GROUP BY approach, COALESCE(device, 'unknown')
ORDER BY CASE approach
           WHEN 'baseline' THEN 1
           WHEN 'baseline_gguf' THEN 2
           WHEN 'rag' THEN 3
           WHEN 'rag_gguf' THEN 4
           WHEN 'fine_tuned' THEN 5
           WHEN 'fine_tuned_with_rag' THEN 6
           ELSE 7 END, 1

SELECT COALESCE(runtime, CASE WHEN approach LIKE '%gguf%' THEN 'gguf' ELSE 'transformers' END) AS runtime,
       CASE approach
           WHEN 'baseline' THEN 'Baseline'
           WHEN 'baseline_gguf' THEN 'Baseline (GGUF)'
           WHEN 'rag' THEN 'RAG'
           WHEN 'rag_gguf' THEN 'RAG (GGUF)'
           WHEN 'fine_tuned' THEN 'Fine-tuned'
           WHEN 'fine_tuned_with_rag' THEN 'Fine-tuned + RAG'
           ELSE approach END AS approach,
       COALESCE(device, 'unknown') AS device,
       COUNT(*) AS n_answers,
       ROUND(AVG("rougeL")::numeric, 4) AS rouge_l,
       ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(time_to_response, generation_time))::numeric, 2) AS ttr_s,
       ROUND((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (
         ORDER BY COALESCE(time_to_response, generation_time)))::numeric, 2) AS p50_ttr_s,
       ROUND((percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (
         ORDER BY COALESCE(time_to_response, generation_time)))::numeric, 2) AS p95_ttr_s,
       ROUND(AVG(tokens_per_sec)::numeric, 2) AS tok_s,
       ROUND(AVG(peak_rss_mb)::numeric, 0) AS rss_mb
FROM evaluation_metrics
WHERE approach IN ('baseline', 'baseline_gguf', 'rag', 'rag_gguf') AND run_id IS NOT NULL AND split_part(run_id, '_', 1) || '_' || split_part(run_id, '_', 2) = ${run:sqlstring}
GROUP BY 1, approach, COALESCE(device, 'unknown')
ORDER BY 1, CASE approach
           WHEN 'baseline' THEN 1
           WHEN 'baseline_gguf' THEN 2
           WHEN 'rag' THEN 3
           WHEN 'rag_gguf' THEN 4
           WHEN 'fine_tuned' THEN 5
           WHEN 'fine_tuned_with_rag' THEN 6
           ELSE 7 END, 3
